item.description: Testing confirms presence of etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for medical use in Australia Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Three people who lost consciousness and were hospitalised in New South Wales after using certain vapes have tested positive for the unregulated anaesthetic agent etomidate, health officials said. NSW health on Friday issued a public warning about vape liquids containing etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Xi Jinping urges trust-based partnership with Australia in Shenzhen bilateral talks
item.description: China and Australia should be “partners that trust each other”, President Xi Jinping told Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese in Shenzhen on Friday. Xi struck an upbeat tone on Beijing’s relationship with Canberra, describing it as “developing steadily” now, in the meeting after the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders’ summit in the southern Chinese city. “China and Australia have neither historical grievances nor fundamental conflicts of interest, and should be partners who trust... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
